🧑‍🏫 LATAA Team

Meet the team

The people behind LATAA — our coaching standards and the leadership team delivering every session.

At LATAA Football Academy, our coaches hold FA and UEFA-accredited coaching qualifications, are FA Safeguarding certified, and Enhanced DBS checked. We are committed to delivering the highest standards of player development in a safe, professional and positive learning environment, where every player is supported, challenged and inspired to reach their full potential.

✓ FA & UEFA Accredited ✓ FA Safeguarding Certified ✓ Enhanced DBS Checked
Photo coming soon

Micah Hyde

Micah Hyde is a UEFA Pro Licence coach, former Premier League player and international footballer with extensive experience in professional football and academy player development. During a distinguished playing career, he achieved promotion four times, bringing a wealth of experience, leadership and knowledge to LATAA Football Academy. With experience coaching and developing players across a number of professional academy environments, Micah has worked with players at every stage of their development journey. He is passionate about helping young players develop their technical ability, football intelligence, confidence and character in a professional, positive and supportive environment.

Photo coming soon

Tyrique Hyde

Tyrique Hyde is a former professional footballer who made his senior debut at just 17 years old. Having played for a number of clubs across the football pyramid before carving out a career in television & social media, Tyrique brings valuable experience from both the football and media industries. Passionate about developing young people, he provides positive mentoring at LATAA Football Academy, helping players develop their technical ability, football intelligence, confidence, character and mindset in a supportive environment. Committed to developing the whole player, Tyrique encourages young people to reach their full potential both on and off the pitch.

Photo coming soon

Mekhi Hyde

Mekhi Hyde is a UEFA-qualified coach and former academy player with playing experience across the English football pyramid and overseas. His experience has given him a strong understanding of the technical, tactical and psychological demands of the modern game. At LATAA Football Academy, Mekhi is committed to developing the next generation of players through high-quality coaching in a positive, professional and challenging environment, helping every player maximise their potential and express themselves with confidence both on and off the pitch.

The Training Week

What players
actually work on

Sessions are designed by a UEFA Pro Licence coach to maximise ball contact, repetition and decision-making.

U7–U9U10–U125:30–7:30PM

Technical Development

Monday sessions focus on developing the technical foundations required to become a confident, effective footballer — designed to maximise ball contact and repetition.

Focus Areas
Ball MasteryBall ProtectionBall Manipulation 1v1 Attacking & Defending2v2 & 3v3 Practices PossessionDefendingFinishing

Technical Development & Game Understanding

As players progress, training increasingly links technical ability with tactical awareness — helping players recognise situations, decide, and execute under pressure.

Part 1 — Technical Development

👤 About Us

Develop the person.
Develop the player.
Develop the performance.

Coaching Philosophy

Develop. Perform. Move Forward.

Our coaching philosophy is centred around creating better players and better people. Players develop best in an environment that is positive, challenging, supportive and player-centred — one where they're encouraged to take ownership of their learning.

We develop players who are technically excellent, tactically intelligent, physically prepared and mentally resilient, while building the character, confidence and values needed to succeed both on and off the pitch.

The goal isn't just better footballers — it's confident, resilient, ambitious young people, ready to succeed in football and in life.

Academy Vision

Develop. Grow. Succeed.

To develop better players, better people, and create a pathway for every player to reach their potential — in a professional, positive and challenging environment.

We support every player to develop their football ability, confidence, character and mindset, and inspire them to love the game, embrace challenges and take ownership of their journey.

Whether the ambition is to play at the highest level, or simply become the best version of themselves.
